{{Top}}
The '''Planetary Governor''' was a position used by the late [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the subsequent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to enforce law and order on member worlds throughout their domains.<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' (novel)]]</ref>

==History==
The [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] instituted towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] placed planetary governors on every planet in the Republic, along with their own [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as security forces. Many of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] lackeys and supporters were given the position as reward for their loyalty.<ref name="ROTSn" />

After the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|transitioned]] into the Empire, the Planetary Governors themselves came under the supervision of the Sector Governors, the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="TNEW">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Governors were seldom native to their planets, so that they wouldn't interfere with local politicking. They were instructed to let local politicians run their own affairs unless such courses of action conflicted with Imperial goals.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The position of the planetary governor was retained during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
